title: Homogenized affine form on a cons vector
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a_0,b\in\mathbb R$ with $b\in\{-1,1\}$, let $a:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb R$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The homogenized affine form with coefficients $(a_0,a)$ evaluated at the vector formed by adjoining $b$ before $x$ equals $a_0b$ plus the linear form with coefficients $a$ evaluated at $x$.
